Interface IF_Event

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
CavePaintings, DoubleInventions, FinalBoost, FinalBuilderBoost, FullSet, FullSetFinal, Hunt, OneTimeBoost, ShamanBoost, ShamanicRitual, StatsBoost, Sustenance, TileBoost
public interface IF_Event extends Serializable
Events' Interface.
This interface follows the "Strategy" Design Pattern, and it used in order to define the polymorphic methods needed in order to handle/display correctly all the Events.

    • getAttributes

      void getAttributes(StringBuilder str1, StringBuilder str2, StringBuilder str3)
      Add Event's info to the StringBuilders for the Terminal.
      This method works by adding the Event's info to the StringBuilders, in order to display it properly on the Terminal.
      Pre: str1 != null && str2 != null && str3 != null
      Parameters:
      str1 - Line containing the identifier of the Event.
      str2 - Line containing the main attribute of the Event.
      str3 - Line containing extra attributes of the Event.
